CP-HOST-01.actual: The Host composes published Task orchestration, Task SQLite owner adapter, Agent Runtime, and loopback HTTP public clients for Execution and Model.

CP-HOST-02.actual: Architecture validation reports no reverse Domain dependency or deep import. Host source defines no business repository or business-state cache; owner state remains in owner packages.

CP-HOST-03.actual: Real loopback transport proves dependency-ordered construction, request routing, stop-accepting, in-flight drain, shutdown, and repeatable restart.

CP-HOST-04.actual: Readiness queries Task integrity, Agent doctor, Execution /ready, and Model /ready on every observation; HTTP availability and owner readiness remain distinct typed facts.

CP-HOST-05.actual: A durable Task is created through Host transport, Host is fully reconstructed, and the Task owner reopens the unchanged PENDING fact without Host cleanup or a state mirror.

evidenceBindings.EV-HOST-02: real Task/Agent construction and Execution/Model HTTP client binding

evidenceBindings.EV-HOST-06: Task state observed before and after complete Host graph reconstruction
